Session date: 11:06 am on 22 August, 2023
[D15:2] Calvin: Hey Dave! Great to hear from you, card night sounds like a blast! Always love having fun with friends. Guess what? I scored a deal to continue collaboration with Frank Ocean! This is a dream come true for me, I've been working hard and it's finally paying off. No words can describe how happy I am.
[D15:3] Dave: Wow Calvin, congrats! Super excited for you. How did this chance come up?
[D15:4] Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I had the opportunity to meet Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo and we clicked. We've been speaking and sharing ideas we arranged a meeting and recorded a song in the studio at my mansion - it's been great!
[D15:5] Dave: Wow, Tokyo sounds like an incredible experience!
[D15:6] Calvin: It was an incredible experience, Dave! The city was buzzing with energy and the festival crowd was so lively - it was like fuel for my soul. Look at this photo, that's amazing!
[D15:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a crowd of people sitting on the grass at night
[D15:7] Dave: Wow, that sounds incredible! What was it like playing at the festival? Must have been an amazing experience.
[D15:8] Calvin: It was a dream come true, Dave! The festival had buzzing energy and a super upbeat crowd. We all felt connected, it was amazing!
[D15:9] Dave: Sounds like you had a blast! Did any other collaborations come out of that performance? Any upcoming concerts we should know about?
[D15:10] Calvin: Yeah Dave, someone even noticed my performance and now we're working together, which is wild. My tour ends soon and I'm heading to Boston. Maybe we can meet up then!
[D15:11] Dave: Sounds great! Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!
[D15:12] Calvin: Of course, Dave can't wait to catch up! I almost forgot, yesterday my friends and I recorded a podcast where we discuss the rapidly evolving rap industry!
[D15:13] Dave: That sounds fantastic! I'm looking forward to listening to your podcast and learning more about the rap industry. Keep up the great work!
[D15:14] Calvin: I'll let you know when the podcast will be uploaded. Take care!
[D15:15] Dave: Sure, Calvin! Looking forward to hearing about it. See ya then!

[D16:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a guitar with a purple glow on it
[D16:19] Dave: That guitar has a gorgeous purple hue. Why did you make it so shiny?
[D16:20] Calvin: I got it customized with a shiny finish because it gives it a unique look. Plus, it goes with my style.
[D16:21] Dave: Good pick! The customized purple glow gives it a unique look that really stands out.
[D16:22] Calvin: Thanks, dude! I dig how it's so unique. It's totally my style!
[D16:23] Dave: Looks great on you! Your unique style really stands out in your music and playing.
[D16:24] Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Trying to stay true to myself and be unique in my music is something that I value, so it's really great to hear that you appreciate it.
[D16:25] Dave: Definitely, staying true to yourself and your style is vital. It makes you unique and your music stand out. Keep it real, bud. You've got something great to give the world.
[D16:25] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage
Session date: 9:19 am on 2 September, 2023

[D17:6] Calvin: Wow, Dave, that's awesome! You should be really proud of yourself for bringing joy to others. I booked a flight ticket to Boston last week! I'm so excited about my upcoming trip to Boston. Look at this! See you soon, buddy!
[D17:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book with a boarding pass and a boarding pass

Session date: 9:15 pm on 13 November, 2023

[D29:3] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two men standing on a sidewalk with a car in the background
[D29:4] Dave: Wow, that's a great pic! Did that person make a big difference during your trip?

[D29:6] Dave: It's great how someone's support and encouragement can really shape our lives! They give us the motivation to keep going and trust ourselves. Do you also find having supportive people around you important for your artist development?
[D29:7] Calvin: Having supportive people is key for me to grow as an artist. They motivate me to get better and stay true to myself. Having support is vital, especially in this tough music industry. Take a look at this photo!
[D29:7] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a group of people sitting around a desk
[D29:8] Dave: Wow, Calvin! Is this a pic of some musicians you're collaborating with?
[D29:9] Calvin: Yeah, I've been supporting some young musicians from a music program. Supporting their passion is amazing and their enthusiasm is inspiring.
[D29:10] Dave: Wow, Calvin, that's amazing! You're really making a difference by supporting the next generation of musicians. It's great to nurture their passion and help them thrive.
[D29:11] Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It's like a torch being passed to keep music alive! These young musicians are very ambitious, I think I will support them for a long time.

[D29:13] Calvin: I'm stoked I made a difference. Paying it forward, ya know? Working with new talent brings new ideas to this. Look at this photo, here's how I'm making a beat for a young artist, he has great potential in music! 
[D29:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man sitting at a desk in front of a computer
[D29:14] Dave: Wow, that's cool! Your music studio looks great. Have you tried out any new ideas lately?
[D29:15] Calvin: Thanks! I'm having fun trying out new sounds and pushing the boundaries. It's great to go for new ideas and see where it takes me - always gotta stay ahead in this.
[D29:16] Dave: Awesome, Calvin! Experimenting and pushing boundaries is key to making our art grow. Can't wait to see where these new ideas take you!
[D29:17] Calvin: Yeah, it's exciting to see where these new ideas lead. It's all about growing and evolving! Have a good one. I need to go now. Take care, Dave!
[D29:18] Dave: For sure, Calvin! Growing and evolving is key for any artist. Don't stop pushing yourself and keep exploring. Can't wait to see what you come up with next! See ya Cal! Take care!

[D14:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a car with a broken engine in the woods
[D14:12] Calvin: Wow Dave, that car is going to look amazing when you're done. How long do you think it will take to restore it?

[D14:14] Calvin: Wow, Dave, I'm really excited to see the end result of your hard work! You've got some serious talent!
[D14:15] Dave: Thanks, Cal! Your support means a lot to me.
[D14:16] Calvin: You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you. Seeing your enthusiasm is amazing. Keep growing, buddy. It'll be worth it! Good luck with that. See ya!

[D1:1] Calvin: Hey Dave! Nice to meet you! How's it going since we talked?
[D1:2] Dave: Hey Calvin! Nice to meet you too! Things have been going well since we last talked. I attended this awesome event recently. It was like a car lover's paradise! They had so many classic cars on show, I was in awe. I even had the opportunity to speak with some of the owners and hear their fascinating stories. It was super inspiring. What about you? Anything exciting happening in your life lately?
[D1:3] Calvin: That event sounds great! Something really exciting happened to me - I just had a big life change! Here's my new mansion - pretty cool huh?
[D1:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a building with a sign on the front of it
[D1:4] Dave: Wow! Congrats on the big change! What inspired you to start this journey?
[D1:5] Calvin: I'm so excited to learn about Japanese culture and get a chance to expand.
[D1:6] Dave: Wow, Calvin, learning about new cultures is awesome! Have you ever been to Japan?
[D1:7] Calvin: Never been there before. Fascinated by the traditions and can't wait to get a taste of the culture.
[D1:8] Dave: Wow, Japan sounds amazing. Can't wait to hear all about it! When are you leaving?
[D1:9] Calvin: I'm heading there next month. I'll be staying in such a nice place while I'm there.


[D1:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a living room with a couch, table, and television
[D1:10] Dave: That looks cozy! Where'd you find a place to stay there?
[D1:11] Calvin: Wow, my agent found me this awesome place, so thankful!
[D1:12] Dave: Awesome! Having a place to stay is key. What are your plans for the trip?
[D1:13] Calvin: I'm planning to explore the city, try out different local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with musicians in the area.
[D1:14] Dave: Sounds great! Collaborating with local musicians would be an amazing experience. How long are you planning to stay in Japan?
[D1:15] Calvin: I'm gonna be in Japan for a few months then off to Boston! I can't wait!
[D1:16] Dave: That's great, can't wait for you to return from your trip. I've been spending lots of time at this beautiful park lately - so calming. Have you been there before?
[D1:16] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a park with a lake and a few boats
[D1:17] Calvin: No, I've never been in that park. Looks like a chill spot. I'll definitely check it out when I'm back. Appreciate the tip!
[D1:18] Dave: Cool! Enjoy your trip! Let me know if you need any more recommendations. Have fun!
[D1:19] Calvin: Thanks, Dave! If I need any help, I'll be sure to let you know. Stay safe!
Session date: 4:45 pm on 26 March, 2023
[D2:1] Calvin: Hey Dave, been a few days, so I wanted to let you in on some cool news.  I just got a new car and it's amazing! Finally owning a luxury car was a dream come true and I'm so stoked.
[D2:2] Dave: Woohoo, Calvin! Congrats on the new car! How's it driving?
[D2:3] Calvin: Nice car! It's an amazing ride - super smooth and real powerful. Like a rockstar behind the wheel! Thanks, man!
[D2:4] Dave: Wow, Calvin! Owning something like this must feel amazing. Is this your first one? Show me a pic! What's it called?
[D2:5] Calvin: Woohoo! I finally got myself this beauty. Here's a pic from yesterday when I took it for a ride. Can't believe I'm actually driving it. Definitely what I deserve after all this hard work. Every time I step in, it's like an adrenaline rush!
[D2:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a red sports car parked on the side of the road
[D2:6] Dave: Calvin, that car looks awesome! You must feel amazing every time you get inside! You deserved it - congrats buddy!
[D2:7] Calvin: Woah, I'm on cloud nine! Hard work pays off. What's up with you, Dave?
[D2:8] Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Doing good. Last weekend, I went to a music festival in Boston - it was awesome! So many cool bands playing and the atmosphere was electric. I love music, it reminded me why I love it. Here's a pic, take a look.
[D2:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a large crowd of people at a concert
[D2:9] Calvin: Wow, sounds like a blast! Which one was your favorite?
[D2:10] Dave: Wow, there were so many great bands! If I had to pick a favorite, it would definitely be Aerosmith. Their performance was incredible. I'll show you a pic I took when they were playing.
[D2:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a concert with a large eagle on the stage
[D2:11] Calvin: Cool! Lovin' Aerosmith.
[D2:12] Dave: I finally saw them live and it was such an amazing experience! He was jamming out to one of their hits. Check out this epic picture of them!
[D2:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two people on stage with guitars and a microphone
[D2:13] Calvin: Cool, Dave! Seeing your favorite singers live must have been wild! Did you get a chance to hang out with them after the show?
[D2:14] Dave: Nah, didn't get to hang with them after the show, but seeing them live was cool enough. It's always a dream to see your favorites performing!
[D2:15] Calvin: Yeah, it's always a dream to see your favorites doing their thing! So glad you got to experience that.
[D2:16] Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Yeah, it was an incredible experience. So, anything new happening in your life?
[D2:17] Calvin: Got a new ride and wrote some new tunes - had a few studio sessions last week and I'm excited to collaborate. Can't wait to share it with everyone!
[D2:18] Dave: Cool, Calvin! Looking forward to hearing your new tunes. Keep me updated on how your collaborations go!
[D2:19] Calvin: Yeah, no worries! I'll definitely let you know how it goes. Cheers!
[D2:20] Dave: Enjoy the collaborations, Calvin! Stay safe!
[D2:21] Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Gonna have fun and stay safe with it. Bye!

Generate up to 1 distinct candidate query plans for the question.

Each plan is a positive conjunctive query. Variables start with "?" and the
literal answer variable "?x" must occur in at least one atom. Each atom has a
short relation, subject and object. The `relation` field contains ONLY the
predicate phrase: write `{"relation": "create", "subject": "Asha",
"object": "?x"}`, never `{"relation": "create(Asha, ?x)", ...}`.
Use at most 4 atoms per plan.

Order plans from most faithful to least preferred:
1. A minimal direct plan only when every requirement can be expressed by one fact. Keep
   qualifiers such as "recently", "after the accident" or "during the workshop"
   inside that relation phrase. Never remove a person, time, place, reason or
   other condition merely because a broader atom is easier to match.
2. A chain plan only when an unnamed intermediate entity must genuinely be found.
3. An intersection plan only when the same answer must independently satisfy
   two relations.

Plans must be meaningfully different. Never pad a plan with artificial atoms such
as recent(?x, true), after(?x, event), type_of(?x, requested_type), or an atom
unconnected to the answer path. Never use true, false or yes as an argument.
Preserve relation direction. For "What has Alice bought?", use buy(Alice, ?x).
Use aggregation "set" for all matching members, "count" for a count, and "none"
for one value. max/min/compare are allowed descriptions but are not executable.

Return JSON exactly in this shape:
{"plans": [
  {"answer_var": "x",
    "atoms": [{"relation": "...", "subject": "...", "object": "?x"}],
    "expected_type": "person|place|date|organization|work|number|other",
    "aggregation": "none|set|max|min|compare|count",
    "fallback": "keyword query"}
]}

Synthetic examples follow. Learn their STRUCTURE; do not copy their entity names
or predicates into the answer. Return fewer than 1 plans when additional
plans would merely be padding. When the question has a genuine intermediate entity,
multiple independent conditions, or an ambiguous predicate, provide at least two
faithful alternatives when possible.

Example 1 — a direct fact needs one plan, not an invented chain.
Question: "Which instrument does Nira play?"
{"plans":[{"answer_var":"x","atoms":[{"relation":"play","subject":"Nira","object":"?x"}],"expected_type":"other","aggregation":"none","fallback":"Nira instrument play"}]}

Example 2 — a real chain uses an unknown intermediate entity.
Question: "In which city is the laboratory led by Omar located?"
{"plans":[{"answer_var":"x","atoms":[{"relation":"lead","subject":"Omar","object":"?y"},{"relation":"located in","subject":"?y","object":"?x"}],"expected_type":"place","aggregation":"none","fallback":"Omar laboratory city"}]}

Example 3 — an intersection repeats the answer variable because both conditions
must describe the same answer.
Question: "Which researcher works at Northstar Institute and studies coral bleaching?"
{"plans":[{"answer_var":"x","atoms":[{"relation":"work at","subject":"?x","object":"Northstar Institute"},{"relation":"study","subject":"?x","object":"coral bleaching"}],"expected_type":"person","aggregation":"set","fallback":"Northstar researcher coral bleaching"}]}

Example 4 — event context stays in the main predicate. It does not become
`after(?x, conference)` or a boolean atom, and it must not be dropped.
Question: "What exhibition did Jun visit after the conference?"
{"plans":[{"answer_var":"x","atoms":[{"relation":"visit after conference","subject":"Jun","object":"?x"}],"expected_type":"other","aggregation":"none","fallback":"Jun exhibition after conference"}]}

Example 5 — plural enumeration uses set; one witness may prove one member.
Question: "Which dishes did Mateo cook for the festival?"
{"plans":[{"answer_var":"x","atoms":[{"relation":"cook for festival","subject":"Mateo","object":"?x"}],"expected_type":"other","aggregation":"set","fallback":"Mateo festival dishes"}]}

Example 6 — counting retrieves the members to count; the number is not an
invented graph constant.
Question: "How many apprentices joined the observatory?"
{"plans":[{"answer_var":"x","atoms":[{"relation":"join","subject":"?x","object":"the observatory"}],"expected_type":"number","aggregation":"count","fallback":"observatory apprentices joined"}]}

Remember: every response is one JSON object with only the `plans` field and the
plan fields shown above. Do not include explanations, markdown or the examples.
